# #[ignore]d tests that are a child process's entry point, for the rust_test
# job in .github/workflows/sami-rust-test.yml: another test of the same binary
# starts the binary again with `--ignored --exact <name>`, so they run inside
# that test, and not as tests of their own. The job fails for an #[ignore]d
# test that no invocation runs and no list names, and for a line here that
# names no such test.
# Each line names the tests that start the child, so that a rename shows: the
# job fails when one of them is no test of the binary, since the child would
# then run nowhere and nothing would say so.
# One per line: <bazel test target> <libtest test name>  <parent>[ and <parent>...]: <reason>
# (each <parent> the full libtest name of a test of the same binary).
//crates/pi-builtins:pi-builtins_test locale::tests::the_ignored_signal_probe  locale::tests::an_inherited_handler_does_not_run_in_the_child_before_exec: its stand-in utility
